name: qrscanner
description: Express app: operator UI + public API endpoints.
comment:node-version: Must run under Node 22 (matching production's actual Lambda runtime), not whatever 'node' happens to resolve to -- jsonwebtoken's transitive dependency buffer-equal-constant-time uses the legacy SlowBuffer API, which Node 25 removed outright (confirmed: fails identically with no symlinks involved, a real version incompatibility, not a test-setup bug). CI pins this via actions/setup-node. Locally, make sure Node 22 is the active version on PATH (nvm/Volta/`brew install node@22` + manual PATH) before running `npm test`.
